procedure_scope: Author-confirmed fresh workflow, backend settings, intervention restrictions and edit counting
participant_background: senior software engineering graduate students; at least 5 years programming experience
assignment: random assignment to 3 groups, one intervention per group
task_pool_in_paper: BigCodeBench tasks unsolved by AdaAssist under Section III-B
task_reuse: same 20 BigCodeBench tasks as the earlier controlled intervention experiment; confirmed by author
task_selection_note: The reused list retains the earlier experiment's selection history, including the /644 to /61 replacement. The manuscript describes random selection; reuse does not establish a fresh random draw or identical starting states.
accepted_edit_definition: Count each participant edit actually submitted and incorporated into the assigned intervention artifact or guidance as one edit operation. Auxiliary interactions such as rerunning tests do not count.
group_restrictions: Each participant adheres to the assigned intervention channel; cross-channel edits are not performed.
relationship_to_earlier_controlled_inter: Reuse the 20 task IDs, start fresh workflows, and use backend evaluation settings with no task time limit
archive_E3_exclusion_reason: Shared task IDs do not turn the earlier API-reviewer trajectories or scores into the nine human participants' trajectories or scores
starting_state: Start a new complete workflow for every participant-task session; generate initial code afresh rather than resume a historical failed candidate
final_evaluation: Use the backend benchmark evaluator and frozen original public/hidden tests; candidate and repair workflow start afresh
time_limit_policy: No participant-task wall-clock limit; null means unlimited, not unknown. Backend generation/repair settings otherwise apply.
